purpose: Exact supplied human observations and conservative evidence categories; no approval or production effects.
reviewDateLimitation: Date of actual inspections was not supplied; recordedOn is consolidation date, not an invented review date.

categoryDefinitions.CONFIRMED: Unqualified primary statement for an existing confirmed gold control; not new independent confirmation.
categoryDefinitions.PRIMARY_CANDIDATE: Supporting direction stated as a candidate; not definitive legal applicability.
categoryDefinitions.TRUE_SPLIT: Human explicitly reports both zoning districts; preserve both.
categoryDefinitions.UNCLEAR: Primary applicability or classification not established; named non-P candidates remain hypotheses.
